answer: The cheapest real defence: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because orchard only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, wharf is enforced in the ledger: Detection is retrospective: payouts for a flagged cluster are clawed back after the fact. Any reef approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
